entities.summary: Azurá Breeona Stevens is an American professional basketball player for the Los Angeles Sparks of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for Hive BC of Unrivaled. Stevens played college basketball at Duke and UConn. She was drafted with the 6th overall pick in the 2018 WNBA draft by the Dallas Wings.
